tools.name: edit_expertise
tools.description:
Read or update an existing expertise in your mcpforx library. Do NOT call this during a tree run — use find_expertise and next_step for that.

READ MODE: call with code only (no tree argument). Returns the full tree in create_expertise schema format, with node ids as database UUIDs. Use these UUIDs

tools.description:

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_expertise · Private data: give_feedback, edit_expertise · Public sink: create_expertise · Destructive: next_step, give_feedback, validate_expertise, edit_expertise, create_expertise.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_expertise · Private data: give_feedback, edit_expertise · Public sink: create_expertise · Destructive: next_step, give_feedback, validate_expertise, edit_expertise, create_expertise

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
